entities.name: Kevin Michael Manning
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Kevin Michael Manning was an Australian Roman Catholic bishop. Having been a parish priest in the Roman Catholic Diocese of Bathurst, he served as Bishop of Armidale (1991–1997) and then as Bishop of Parramatta (1997–2010).
